title: ticfac Phase 4b: subscription seats as flat-rate credentials
description: Peter, 2026-09-02: get to subscriptions once the cloud factory is live on the new reconciler. Use Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) and Claude (Pro/Max) subscription seats for cloud jobs instead of metered API keys, via omp's auth-broker / auth-gateway, which already handles these providers locally. Scope: broker reachable from the job sandbox as a host-issued credential (JobSpec.credentials, SPEC §4.3); a subscription routing option beside the AI Gateway route in the image; stop = the broker refuses to issue (Appendix A #1); quota exhaustion reported as its own failure class, never as a broken route; per-role routing (e.g. review on a seat, implementation metered, or vice versa); no cost budget on the flat-rate rung — it works or it does not, wall-clock and cancellation still apply. Open decisions for Peter before this starts: seat terms of service for this use (flag once, do not relitigate), and where the broker process lives (operator laptop, a small always-on host, or a Cloudflare container).
acceptance_criteria: Gate: an epic completes on the cloud host with every job's model access issued through a subscription credential and no metered spend recorded; a stop mid-run is observed as the broker refusing to issue; a forced quota exhaustion surfaces as a distinct failure class in the run record.
